summary.text: CISA issued a cybersecurity advisory about Siemens Industrial Edge Management, stating that Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) is affecting Industrial Edge. The advisory suggests checking the setup for no management applications installed. If no applications are installed, no action is required.
